regions.today: During the afternoon outbreaks of rain will spread from the west, turning heavy and more persistent at times in southern counties this evening. Highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees in fresh and gusty southwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Largely dry tonight with clear spells and the odd isolated showers mainly in western parts. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees in light to moderate and occasionally fresh southwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: Blustery tomorrow with sunny spells, scattered showers and a fresh and gusty west to northwest wind. The showers will become more isolated by evening as winds gradually ease too. Highest temperatures of 14 to 17 degrees.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Monday and Tuesday.
